name: create_project
description: Create a permanent native Project, the top container for Epics, Modules, Tasks and Atomics, together with its Runbook and Decisions documents. Required: team_id, title, description; repository_path must be an absolute existing local Git checkout and is optional for planning, as is repository_url — neither URL is ever fetched. Confirms the native Project URL and document links as text; isError marks a failed create. request_id becomes the native Project ID, so retry an uncertain create with identical arguments. Example: {"request_id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","actor":"codex:session","team_id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002","title":"Billing platform","description":"One readable paragraph."}

name: get_context
description: Read the current native Project, Issue, Document or ProjectUpdate by type and id, or by a native Linear URL alone with the type inferred; non-native or decorated links fail resolution explicitly. view=lead/reviewer adds assignment, current reports, review, questions and ancestor document links. detail is independent of view: brief keeps status, assignee, current result/blockers/next guidance, the latest applicable handoff and routes to full documents — the recommended daily depth — while omitted detail or full returns existing complete content. Child pending/status drift withholds exact Module counts and appears as explicit discrepancies. Read-only; reads never repair state. Example: {"id":"https://linear.app/team/issue/TEAM-7/module-title","view":"lead","detail":"brief"}

id.description: UUID or native Linear permalink of the selected entity.

url.description: Native Linear permalink; the type is inferred when omitted.

view.description: lead adds the responsible assignment view; reviewer adds review evidence.

detail.description: brief keeps status, assignee, current result/blockers/guidance, the latest applicable handoff and routes to full documents; full returns existing complete content.

name: get_overview
description: Read one complete Project overview — active Epics with frozen Modules, standalone Modules, Atomics, retired work, open questions and work awaiting review — plus an unpublished ProjectUpdate draft and a fresh opaque cursor. A later call with that cursor returns only the changes and a new cursor; a lost, expired or foreign cursor returns the full overview with baseline_expired=true instead of guessing. Incomplete membership or native drift fails explicitly. Read-only; never publishes an update or starts work. Example: {"project_id":"https://linear.app/team/project/passport"}

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous overview of the same Project.

name: list_items
description: List native Projects, Issues, Documents, Comments or ProjectUpdates with opaque pagination (first/after; follow pageInfo.endCursor). Comment and ProjectUpdate pages embed normalized activity records; target_type with target_id scopes Comments, project_id scopes updates, parent_id scopes child Issues. order_by=priority returns one complete Project sibling group sorted by Linear priority; ordering is advisory and never gates transitions. Example: {"type":"issue","parent_id":"https://linear.app/team/issue/TEAM-8/epic-title","kind":"module"}

priority.description: Native Linear priority: 0 none, 1 urgent, 2 high, 3 medium, 4 low.

name: move_status
description: Check or perform one guarded status transition. check_only=true is a read-only preview returning allowed/conditions and writes nothing. Start parents before children and close children before parents; no transition ever cascades to children, and blocking conditions are reported explicitly from fresh native state. name: record_commits
description: Import 1-20 concrete hexadecimal commit hashes from the assigned checkout of an In Progress code Task or Atomic. Each commit message must carry a Conventional Commit subject plus standalone Result: and Checks: sections (optional Notes:); the imported text fills result/check_result and is journaled as one progress comment per report. Sources are validated before any write and deduplicated per round; status never changes and Git is never written. Retry an uncertain import with identical request_id and arguments. Example: {"request_id":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b","actor":"codex:session","work_id":"https://linear.app/team/issue/TEAM-9/task-title","commits":["0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567"]}
